items.text: Movies tab: Trending, Hollywood, Bollywood, Kids, Cartoons and Anime rails, streamed through vidsrc.sh with live TMDB search.
Browser tab with a sidebar layout, up to six tabs, and background tabs discarded after a minute to hold memory down.
Scramjet is now the recommended proxy engine, with libcurl as the recommended transport. Ultraviolet stays available as a fallback.
40 themes, 9 glass recipes and 11 tints, all pickable from Settings > Appearance.
Custom backgrounds: upload an image or link one from anywhere on the web, with an optional extra dim.
Every background effect (light beams, dust, sheen, pointer highlight, backdrop blur, drift) can now be switched off individually.
GN-Math added as a second game provider alongside the CKV collection, switchable in Settings > Proxy.
Low RAM mode trims blur, the dust canvas and animated sheens. Defaults on for light devices.
Static hosting support: `npm run build:static` produces a folder that runs on any static host with no backend.
A changelog now lives in Settings > About, and the app carries a version number.

The backend connection no longer drops every minute or so. The server keeps connections alive past typical proxy idle timeouts and heartbeats on the protocol level; the client needs two failed pings before reporting an outage.
Movie posters and game covers load lazily and release their decoded bitmaps once scrolled away.
The server's in-memory game cache is 48 MB with a 2 MB per-entry ceiling, and large files stream straight through instead of buffering. Second visits don't touch GitHub.
Static assets ship long-lived cache headers, and responses down to 512 B get compressed.
Scramjet's ES module build was being injected as a classic script, so the proxy never started on Firefox. It now loads the IIFE build.
An engine that fails to start now falls back to Ultraviolet instead of leaving the proxy dead, and repeated errors no longer stack up as toasts.
Swapped the deprecated wisp-server-node for the maintained wisp-js. Same protocol, no deprecation warning, and the tunnel refuses to reach loopback or private addresses.
Static builds pointed CKV and GN-Math at the local /cdn proxy, which doesn't exist without a backend. They now use jsDelivr.
Tapping the homepage logo throws confetti. There's no cooldown, so you can just spam it.
A vercel.json that runs the whole app — Wisp websocket included — as a single Vercel Function.
